:::{#exr-sum-deviations-zero}
#### Summing the deviations from the sample mean

Find $\sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sum-deviations-zero}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs - \sumin \predbar
&& \text{(distribute the sum over the terms)}\\
&= \sumin \predvar_\iobs - n \predbar
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= n \predbar - n \predbar
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \predbar$)}\\
&= 0
&& \text{(subtract)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The same steps with $\outvar_\iobs$ in place of $\predvar_\iobs$
show that $\sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \outbar) = 0$.

:::
